### Autocomplete.Root

<ParamField body="Root.actionsRef" type="RefObject&lt;AutocompleteRootActions | null&gt;">
  A ref to imperative actions.
  - `unmount`: Manually unmounts the autocomplete.
  Call this after any externally controlled closing animation finishes.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Root.autoHighlight" type="boolean | &quot;always&quot;" default="false">
  Whether the first matching item is highlighted automatically.
  - `true`: highlight after the user types and keep the highlight while the query changes.
  - `'always'`: always highlight the first item.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Root.defaultOpen" type="boolean" default="false">
  Whether the popup is initially open.

  To render a controlled popup, use the `open` prop instead.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Root.defaultValue" type="string | number | readonly string[]">
  The uncontrolled input value of the autocomplete when it's initially rendered.

  To render a controlled autocomplete, use the `value` prop instead.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Root.disabled" type="boolean" default="false">
  Whether the component should ignore user interaction.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Root.filter" type="((item: Items[number][&quot;items&quot;][number], query: string, itemToString?: ((item: Items[number][&quot;items&quot;][number]) =&gt; string) | undefined) =&gt; boolean) | null">
  Filter function used to match items against the input query.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Root.filteredItems" type="readonly Items[number][&quot;items&quot;][number][] | readonly Group&lt;Items[number][&quot;items&quot;][number]&gt;[]">
  Filtered items to display in the list.
  When provided, the list uses these items instead of filtering the `items` prop internally.
  When `items` is also provided, this array must preserve its flat or grouped structure.
  Nullish entries are not supported, as in `items`.
  Use when you want to control filtering logic externally with the `useFilter()` hook.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Root.form" type="string">
  Identifies the form that owns the internal input.
  Useful when the autocomplete is rendered outside the form.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Root.grid" type="boolean" default="false">
  Whether list items are presented in a grid layout.
  When enabled, arrow keys navigate across rows and columns inferred from DOM rows.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Root.highlightItemOnHover" type="boolean" default="true">
  Whether moving the pointer over items should highlight them.
  Disabling this prop allows CSS `:hover` to be differentiated from the `:focus` (`data-highlighted`) state.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Root.id" type="string">
  The id of the component.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Root.inline" type="boolean" default="false">
  Whether the list is rendered inline without using the component's own popup.

  Specify `open` unconditionally in conjunction with this prop so the list is considered
  visible: `<Autocomplete.Root inline open>`
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Root.inputRef" type="Ref&lt;HTMLInputElement&gt;">
  A ref to the hidden input element.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Root.items" type="readonly { items: readonly any[]; }[]" required>
  The items to be displayed in the list.
  Can be either a flat array of items or an array of groups with items.
  Nullish entries are not supported: remove them from the data before passing it.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Root.itemToStringValue" type="((itemValue: Items[number][&quot;items&quot;][number]) =&gt; string)">
  When the item values are objects (`<Autocomplete.Item value={object}>`), this function converts the object value to a string representation for both display in the input and form submission.
  If the shape of the object is `{ value, label }`, the label will be used automatically without needing to specify this prop.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Root.keepHighlight" type="boolean" default="false">
  Whether the highlighted item should be preserved when the pointer leaves the list.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Root.limit" type="number" default="-1">
  The maximum number of items to display in the list.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Root.locale" type="LocalesArgument">
  The locale to use for string comparison.
  Defaults to the user's runtime locale.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Root.loopFocus" type="boolean" default="true">
  Whether to loop keyboard focus back to the input when the end of the list is reached while using the arrow keys. The first item can then be reached by pressing &lt;kbd>ArrowDown&lt;/kbd> again from the input, or the last item can be reached by pressing &lt;kbd>ArrowUp&lt;/kbd> from the input.
  The input is always included in the focus loop per [ARIA Authoring Practices](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/combobox/).
  When disabled, focus does not move when on the last element and the user presses &lt;kbd>ArrowDown&lt;/kbd>, or when on the first element and the user presses &lt;kbd>ArrowUp&lt;/kbd>.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Root.modal" type="boolean" default="false">
  Determines if the popup enters a modal state when open.
  - `true`: user interaction is limited to the popup: document page scroll is locked and pointer interactions on outside elements are disabled.
  - `false`: user interaction with the rest of the document is allowed.

  On touch devices, a `true` modal blocks outside taps but leaves the page scrollable unless the popup spans nearly the full viewport width, matching native iOS behavior.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Root.mode" type="&quot;both&quot; | &quot;inline&quot; | &quot;list&quot; | &quot;none&quot;" default="list">
  Controls how the autocomplete behaves with respect to list filtering and inline autocompletion.
  - `list` (default): items are dynamically filtered based on the input value. The input value does not change based on the active item.
  - `both`: items are dynamically filtered based on the input value, which will temporarily change based on the active item (inline autocompletion).
  - `inline`: items are static (not filtered), and the input value will temporarily change based on the active item (inline autocompletion).
  - `none`: items are static (not filtered), and the input value will not change based on the active item.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Root.name" type="string">
  Identifies the field when a form is submitted.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Root.onItemHighlighted" type="((highlightedValue: Items[number][&quot;items&quot;][number] | undefined, eventDetails: HighlightEventDetails) =&gt; void)">
  Callback fired when an item is highlighted or unhighlighted.
  Receives the highlighted item value (or `undefined` if no item is highlighted) and event details with a `reason` property describing why the highlight changed.
  The `reason` can be:
  - `'keyboard'`: the highlight changed due to keyboard navigation.
  - `'pointer'`: the highlight changed due to pointer hovering.
  - `'none'`: the highlight changed programmatically.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Root.onOpenChange" type="((open: boolean, eventDetails: AutocompleteRootChangeEventDetails) =&gt; void)">
  Event handler called when the popup is opened or closed.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Root.onOpenChangeComplete" type="((open: boolean) =&gt; void)">
  Event handler called after any animations complete when the popup is opened or closed.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Root.onValueChange" type="((value: string, eventDetails: AutocompleteRootChangeEventDetails) =&gt; void)">
  Event handler called when the input value of the autocomplete changes.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Root.open" type="boolean">
  Whether the popup is currently open. Use when controlled.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Root.openOnInputClick" type="boolean" default="false">
  Whether the popup opens when clicking the input.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Root.readOnly" type="boolean" default="false">
  Whether the user should be unable to choose a different option from the popup.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Root.required" type="boolean" default="false">
  Whether the user must choose a value before submitting a form.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Root.submitOnItemClick" type="boolean" default="false">
  Whether clicking an item should submit the autocomplete's owning form.
  By default, clicking an item via a pointer or &lt;kbd>Enter&lt;/kbd> key does not submit the owning form.
  Useful when the autocomplete is used as a single-field form search input.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Root.value" type="string | number | readonly string[]">
  The input value of the autocomplete. Use when controlled.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Root.virtualized" type="boolean" default="false">
  Whether the items are being externally virtualized.
</ParamField>

### Autocomplete.Popup

<ParamField body="Popup.align" type="&quot;center&quot; | &quot;end&quot; | &quot;start&quot;" default="start">
  How to align the popup relative to the specified side.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Popup.alignOffset" type="number | OffsetFunction" default="0">
  Additional offset along the alignment axis in pixels.
  Also accepts a function that returns the offset to read the dimensions of the anchor
  and positioner elements, along with its side and alignment.

  The function takes a `data` object parameter with the following properties:
  - `data.anchor`: the dimensions of the anchor element with properties `width` and `height`.
  - `data.positioner`: the dimensions of the positioner element with properties `width` and `height`.
  - `data.side`: which side of the anchor element the positioner is aligned against.
  - `data.align`: how the positioner is aligned relative to the specified side.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Popup.anchor" type="Element | VirtualElement | RefObject&lt;Element | null&gt; | (() =&gt; Element | VirtualElement | null) | null">
  An element to position the popup against.
  By default, the popup will be positioned against the trigger.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Popup.className" type="string | ((state: ComboboxPopupState) =&gt; string | undefined)">
  CSS class applied to the element, or a function that
  returns a class based on the component's state.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Popup.collisionPadding" type="Padding" default="5">
  Additional space to maintain from the edge of the collision boundary.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Popup.container" type="HTMLElement | ShadowRoot | RefObject&lt;HTMLElement | ShadowRoot | null&gt; | null">
  Element the popup is portaled into. Defaults to the theme portal container.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Popup.finalFocus" type="boolean | RefObject&lt;HTMLElement | null&gt; | ((closeType: InteractionType) =&gt; boolean | void | HTMLElement | null)">
  Determines the element to focus when the popup is closed.

  - `false`: Do not move focus.
  - `true`: Move focus based on the default behavior (trigger or previously focused element).
  - `RefObject`: Move focus to the ref element.
  - `function`: Called with the interaction type (`mouse`, `touch`, `pen`, or `keyboard`).
    Return an element to focus, `true` to use the default behavior, or `false`/`undefined` to do nothing.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Popup.initialFocus" type="boolean | RefObject&lt;HTMLElement | null&gt; | ((openType: InteractionType) =&gt; boolean | void | HTMLElement | null)">
  Determines the element to focus when the popup is opened.

  - `false`: Do not move focus.
  - `true`: Move focus based on the default behavior (first tabbable element or popup).
  - `RefObject`: Move focus to the ref element.
  - `function`: Called with the interaction type (`mouse`, `touch`, `pen`, or `keyboard`).
    Return an element to focus, `true` to use the default behavior, or `false`/`undefined` to do nothing.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Popup.render" type="ReactElement&lt;unknown, string | JSXElementConstructor&lt;any&gt;&gt; | ComponentRenderFn&lt;HTMLProps, ComboboxPopupState&gt;">
  Allows you to replace the component's HTML element
  with a different tag, or compose it with another component.

  Accepts a `ReactElement` or a function that returns the element to render.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Popup.side" type="&quot;bottom&quot; | &quot;inline-end&quot; | &quot;inline-start&quot; | &quot;left&quot; | &quot;right&quot; | &quot;top&quot;" default="bottom">
  Which side of the anchor element to align the popup against.
  May automatically change to avoid collisions.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Popup.sideOffset" type="number | OffsetFunction" default="8">
  Distance between the anchor and the popup in pixels.
  Also accepts a function that returns the distance to read the dimensions of the anchor
  and positioner elements, along with its side and alignment.

  The function takes a `data` object parameter with the following properties:
  - `data.anchor`: the dimensions of the anchor element with properties `width` and `height`.
  - `data.positioner`: the dimensions of the positioner element with properties `width` and `height`.
  - `data.side`: which side of the anchor element the positioner is aligned against.
  - `data.align`: how the positioner is aligned relative to the specified side.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Popup.style" type="CSSProperties | ((state: ComboboxPopupState) =&gt; CSSProperties | undefined)">
  Style applied to the element, or a function that
  returns a style object based on the component's state.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="Popup.width" type="string | number">
  Width of the popup. Overrides its default minimum anchor width.
</ParamField>
